Today's selection covers 91 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 59 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: China's Moonshot AI claims Kimi K3 can rival OpenAI and Anthropic

• **Security Alert**: In Other News: Iran Tracks US Military Phones, CrashStealer macOS Malware, CVD Blueprint
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 38 articles published in the last 24 hours
